rationale: Henry's work as CTO of AIEngine in ML infrastructure complements Nathan's focus on embodied AI and physics-informed learning at Afore and Extropic. Nathan's conviction that hardware-software co-design is critical for next-gen AI systems and his background in probabilistic methods could offer valuable perspective on AIEngine's technical direction, while Henry's infrastructure expertise may be relevant to Nathan's work building systems grounded in physical principles.
intro_message: Henry Kendall, meet Nathan Yu — Nathan's deep expertise in embodied AI, probabilistic methods, and hardware-software co-design could be valuable context for AIEngine's ML infrastructure work.
